retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered rustic composition featuring a high-contrast sepia photograph framed by weathered wood textures and distressed display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered vertical layout consisting of a central high-contrast, grainy sepia photograph of a rustic porch, sandwiched between two tan textured banners containing distressed black text, all enclosed within a dark border and a weathered wood-grain background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic focal point framed by horizontal text banners
High-contrast black and sepia tones against a warm tan background
Rough, organic textures of wood and paper contrasting with sharp graphic borders
Symmetrical placement of illustrative icons flanking the top header
coreInvariants: High-contrast threshold effect on the central image
Distressed, irregular edges on all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central photograph occupies the middle 60% of the vertical space, showing a wide-angle view of a wooden porch.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black and white 'Advisory' badge in the lower-left quadrant of the central image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top header text, move down through the high-contrast porch scene, and rest on the bottom title banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized through the tan banners and the dark framing borders to separate the complex textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and tan tones providing a warm, aged base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows, text, and structural borders.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white highlights within the high-contrast photograph.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between deep blacks and light tans.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and grayscale

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, eroded edges suggesting ink bleed or woodblock printing
Variable stroke thickness with intentional 'grunge' artifacts
Slightly inconsistent baseline for a hand-stamped feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two variations of distressed serif fonts to maintain a cohesive rustic theme.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the distressed, western-adjacent serif feel.
Matches the eroded, stamped aesthetic of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a rustic background featuring a weathered wood grain texture. In the center, place a high-contrast, grainy sepia photograph of an old wooden porch with a bench and a door. Add two horizontal tan-colored paper-texture banners at the top and bottom, framed by thin black borders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply distressed, black, all-caps serif typography to the top and bottom tan banners. Flank the top text with two symmetrical black rooster silhouettes. Add a small black and white rectangular advisory badge in the lower-left corner of the central photo.

verificationChecks: Is the central image high-contrast sepia?
Are the text banners tan with a paper texture?
Is the outer frame a weathered wood grain?
Is the typography distressed and eroded?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wood grain texture
Level of contrast in the central photograph
Amount of erosion/distress on the typography
Width of the black framing borders
mustRedesign: Any clean, modern, or high-fidelity photographic elements

mustAchieve: Gritty, tactile texture across all surfaces

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the wood grain looks weathered and not like a clean floorboard.
Check that the high-contrast photo retains recognizable porch elements.
Verify that the text looks stamped or printed, not digitally typed.
Confirm the symmetrical icons are balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Frame + High-Contrast Sepia Center + Distressed Banner Typography
